too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reset_sent: If an account exists for this email, we sent a reset link.
password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
reset_link_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
no_organizers: You don't have access to any organizer yet.
tenant_placeholder: Events, seat plans and orders will appear here.
name: Name
change_password_hint: You will be signed out on all other devices.

forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

{invitedBy} has invited you to manage {organizer} on Ticketbox.

{link}

invite_member_description: New users receive an email to choose their password. Existing users get access right away.
remove_member_description: They lose access to this organizer immediately. Their account itself is kept.
last_owner: An organizer needs at least one owner.
sales_start_hint: Empty: as soon as the event is on sale.
translation_optional: Optional. Empty fields show the {language} text.
event_slug_taken: Another event already uses this address.
sales_end_before_start: The sales end must be after the sales start.
categories_description: Price levels for this event. Seats are assigned to them in the seat plan.
invalid_price: Please enter a price like 45 or 45.50.
reductions_description: Lower prices for groups such as students or seniors. Buyers choose one per ticket; eligibility is checked at the entrance.
no_reductions: No reductions yet. Without reductions, every ticket costs the full price.
reduction_hint: Checked by a person at the entrance, no codes needed.
select_a_category: Please select at least one category.
invalid_percent: Please enter a percentage between 0.01 and 100.
price_overview_description: What a ticket costs for each category and reduction. Percentages are rounded to 5 Rappen for CHF.
seat_plans_description: Venue layouts with their seats. One plan can be used by many events.
new_seat_plan_description: Upload a picture of the venue. You place the seats on it in the next step.
seat_plan_image_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
seat_plan_image_invalid: Please choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
seat_plan_image_too_large: The image is larger than 5 MB.

tool_select_hint: Click a seat or drag a box to select; drag selected seats to move them. Shift adds to the selection.
tool_seat_hint: Click to place single seats; numbers count up automatically.
tool_row_hint: Drag from the first to the last seat of a row. The next row label is suggested afterwards.
editor_shortcuts: Shortcuts: Delete removes, arrow keys move (Shift: 10 px), Esc clears the selection, Ctrl/⌘ + A selects all.
unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

seat_plan_out_of_bounds: Some seats are outside the image.
change_seat_plan_description: All category assignments of this event are removed.
event_has_no_seat_plan: This event has no seat plan yet.

seating_needs_categories: Create categories first; seats are sold in a category.
paint_hint: Click seats or drag a box over them.
tool_detect_hint: Click on one seat drawn in the plan. Similar boxes are found and their numbers read; this takes a few seconds.
tool_rows_hint: Rows are found automatically (orange: not named yet). Click the rows in order; each click names one row and counts the name up.
detect_nothing_found: No seats found. Click inside a seat box drawn in the plan.
review_hint: Seats worth a look. Click one to select it.
